Luke Littler by Michael Errigo Piaras Ó Mídheach—Sportsfile/Getty Images Luke Littler, the 19-year-old darts player from England, has shaken the foundation of his sport, shattering records and exploding to global fame.
It’s no wonder his nickname is “the Nuke.” He reached the Professional Darts Corporation (PDC) world championship final at 16 and won his first title the following year.

results.title: Luke “The Nuke” Littler Player Profile – Darting HQ
results.content:
From Warrington youth leagues to back-to-back world titles Luke Littler started throwing darts as a child in Warrington and was winning on the WDF youth circuit by 15.
In 2023, his first year on the PDC Development Tour, he won five titles and capped the season by beating Gian van Veen to lift the PDC World Youth Championship .

results.title: World Darts Championship 2026 final result: Luke Littler wins PDC title with masterclass against Gian van Veen - BBC Sport
results.content:
Luke Littler produced a stunning display to thrash Gian van Veen 7-1 and win the PDC World Championship for the second year running.
His second victory in only his third appearance at Alexandra Palace also means that only Taylor, with 14, and Michael van Gerwen, on three, have more PDC world titles than Littler.
Retaining his world title caps a remarkable year for Littler in which he has completely dominated darts.
